claude_proposed_widenings.name: resource-less non-spell triggered_reaction mechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item triggered_reaction family requires an ActivationResource and RestResetCadence, but Gloves of Missile Snaring has no per-rest or charge pool. It only spends the normal reaction quota when the trigger occurs.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you're hit by an attack roll made with a Ranged or Thrown weapon while wearing these gloves, you can take a Reaction to reduce the damage...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.free_hand_available
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The damage-reduction rider is additionally gated by hand state. Current equipment predicates can express wearing/holding/wielding, but not "you have a free hand."
